meta.source: Redesign 2026-10-05: palette from the two book imprints (the-bent-one/src/app.css, book-sun-and-moon/tailwind.config.js), type shared with Notes and the books, copy and mark from stronghandssoftheart.com. Supersedes the stone/system-sans site.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm paper by day (The Bent One's paper); Mia's dusk blue at night.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Second ground: alternating sections, quiet panels, input fills.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised sheet: cards, labels, menus. Separated by rule, never by shadow.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders. Decorative strength (1.4:1 light, 1.8:1 night).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on paper, paper-2 and card (14.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, nav, specs on labels (7.5:1 or better everywhere).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, placeholders (5.2:1 or better on every ground).

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: The signature: clay red. Primary buttons, links, the mark on product, the active state. As text on paper, paper-2 and card (4.9:1+ light, 4.7:1+ night); on earth-tint (4.8:1 light, 4.6:1 night).

tokens.name: earth-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an earth fill or link.

tokens.name: earth-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind earth text: badges, selected rows, the label band.

tokens.name: on-earth
tokens.usage: Text on an earth fill (5.7:1 light, 5.4:1 night). Paper by day, dusk at night; never pure white.

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: The counterweight: slate blue. Secondary emphasis, the upper half of the seal, cool scents. As text on the grounds (5.2:1+ light, 6.8:1+ night).

tokens.name: air-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind air text.

tokens.name: on-air
tokens.usage: Text on an air fill.

tokens.name: air-deep
tokens.usage: The deep surface: contact section, footer, night pages. Always paired with on-air-deep.

tokens.name: on-air-deep
tokens.usage: Text on air-deep (13.5:1 / 14:1): Mia's moonlight.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Warmth for art and texture only: text selection at 45%, the glow in illustrations. Never text (2.4:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive actions only.

tokens.name: bent-paper
tokens.usage: The Bent One imprint: page paper (same as house paper).

tokens.name: bent-page
tokens.usage: The Bent One: backdrop behind the page.

tokens.name: bent-ink
tokens.usage: The Bent One: story text.

tokens.name: bent-red
tokens.usage: The Bent One: the bent line, its icon and focus colour (5.6:1 on bent-paper).

tokens.name: bent-ochre
tokens.usage: The Bent One: art only.

tokens.name: bent-water
tokens.usage: The Bent One: water in the art (5.2:1).

tokens.name: bent-glow
tokens.usage: The Bent One: window glow in the art.

tokens.name: mia-paper
tokens.usage: Mia, the Sun, and the Moon: caption-card paper.

tokens.name: mia-ink
tokens.usage: Mia: story text on mia-paper (13.1:1).

tokens.name: mia-ember
tokens.usage: Mia: CTA fill and kicker. 4.1:1 on mia-paper: as text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+.

tokens.name: mia-blush
tokens.usage: Mia: selection on day pages.

tokens.name: mia-sun
tokens.usage: Mia: the sun in the mark. Art only.

tokens.name: mia-dusk
tokens.usage: Mia: night pages (same as house air-deep and the night ground).

tokens.name: mia-moonlight
tokens.usage: Mia: the moon in the mark; text on mia-dusk.

families.text: "Source Serif 4", "Iowan Old Style", Palatino, Georgia, serif

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Soap, books and software. Made by one person in Florida.
styles.usage: The hero statement, clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 4.5rem). Weight 500; the last phrase in italic earth. A fact, not a motto.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The full name beside the mark in the header (web). On product the name is always the SHSH lockup: SH, the mark, SH, in this style; the lockup files are in Logos.

styles.name: label-name
styles.usage: Scent or product name on a soap label (Fraunces italic, as Mia's cover title).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: This page says what I make, what is ready, and what is not. Nothing here is a promise.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs under a title, ink-soft.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two short children's books, written for my kids and my nephew, free to read in English and Spanish.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Cold-process soap, made in small batches in Florida. Not for sale yet.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation, UPPERCASE, ink-soft; earth when current.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Label above a section title, UPPERCASE, earth.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges in the exact vocabulary: Available, Free, In progress, Planned (with a date), Paused (with since when), Retired. Earth on earth-tint.

styles.name: label-kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase line under the wordmark on a label (print size; 10.7px on screen).

styles.name: label-spec
styles.usage: Weight, ingredients and maker line on a label (print size; 9.3px on screen). Nothing on a label goes smaller.

styles.name: mia-title
styles.usage: Mia cover title (Fraunces with SOFT 70, WONK 1). 48px mobile.

styles.name: story
styles.sample: For Mia and Dario, with all my love
styles.usage: Story text on a caption card. 18px mobile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; between a label's lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between siblings.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; header height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding, mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding, desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, the icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and labels (the die-cut corner of a sticker).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (pills, as in Mia) and the back-to-top button.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: Only for a physical object shown on screen: a label mockup, a book page. UI uses rule, not shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.
